note: 开发站会十段，非生产故障会；固定角色报告进度、阻塞与今日承诺，技术展开另约会后。未配音，无时间轴。

series.title: 运维工具站会：评审、测试缺口与团队依赖
series.premise: 团队开发只读资产查询工具，距离内部演示还有两天；分页接口契约未定、评审等待，开发阶段无生产故障。
series.outcome: 限定本周只读范围，安排评审与契约负责人；拆开解析、契约和性能任务，今日提交测试证据，真实接口未验收的部分明确使用fixture，会后讨论不阻塞站会。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 未来场景候选，非实际出现；只依赖既有p001-p350或本稿早段，不引用并行稿。

dialogues.title: 先对齐本周只读目标
dialogues.premise: 今日站会开始，先确认两天后演示的范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出演示目标、非目标与站会结束时间。

lines.en: Okay, we're keeping the read-only scope. Today's standup has a ten-minute hard stop.
lines.zh: 好，保持只读范围，今天站会十分钟到点结束。

lines.en: Does that exclude editing inventory records? Review complexity changes if writes sneak in.
lines.zh: 这排除修改资产记录吗？混入写功能会改变评审复杂度。

lines.en: Yes, listing and filtering records only. Just to confirm, bulk updates stay out, right?
lines.zh: 是，只列出和筛选记录，确认一下，批量更新不做，对吧？

lines.en: The demo should show two inventory pages. Maybe a third if the fixture is ready.
lines.zh: 演示展示两页资产，fixture就绪的话可能展示第三页。

lines.en: Two pages already exercise cursor handling. A third page isn't the acceptance gate.
lines.zh: 两页已覆盖游标处理，第三页不是验收关卡。

lines.en: Good, one action item is confirming ownership. Who has bandwidth for the parser review?
lines.zh: 好，一项任务是确认负责人，谁有时间评审解析器？

lines.en: I can review after my platform check. Send the focused change, not unrelated cleanup.
lines.zh: 平台检查后我能评审，发聚焦变更，不夹带无关整理。

lines.en: The export feature can wait another sprint. Let's park that until this demo works.
lines.zh: 导出功能可以等下个迭代，当前演示跑通前先放下。

lines.en: I'll report test progress after the implementation. We should surface blockers before assigning more work.
lines.zh: 实现进度后我汇报测试，增加任务前先暴露阻塞。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll cover the API dependency next. No production rollout is planned this week.
lines.zh: 同意，接着我说接口依赖，本周不计划生产上线。

dialogues.title: 昨天完成了什么
dialogues.premise: 只读范围明确，Raj报告实现进度与今日安排。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分已完成实现、待评审代码和未验收集成。

lines.en: The parser is up for review now. Yesterday I finished cursor parsing and filtering.
lines.zh: 解析器现在待评审，昨天完成游标解析与筛选。

lines.en: Does it run against the real endpoint? Or does that progress describe fixtures only?
lines.zh: 是用真实接口跑过，还是仅指fixture进度？

lines.en: Fixtures only until the contract is confirmed. Just to confirm, that's clearly labelled, right?
lines.zh: 契约确认前只用fixture，确认一下，已明确标注，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, my integration note states that limitation. The read-only scope hasn't changed since yesterday.
lines.zh: 是，我的集成说明写了这个限制，只读范围没有变化。

lines.en: Parser tests pass for valid cursors. Malformed cursor coverage still needs additional cases.
lines.zh: 合法游标测试通过，异常游标还需要补用例。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for those cases? A rough estimate is enough right now.
lines.zh: 好，补用例预计多久？现在给大概估算即可。

lines.en: I'll review the existing parser this morning. Additional tests can land in that change.
lines.zh: 今天上午评审现有解析器，新增测试可放同一变更。

lines.en: I'm on it before lunch, roughly two hours. Then I'll be heads-down on error handling.
lines.zh: 我午饭前做，大约两小时，之后专注错误处理。

lines.en: Please include the exact rejected input shapes. We need reproducible cases, not just descriptions.
lines.zh: 请附具体拒绝输入结构，需要可复现用例，不只是描述。

lines.en: I'll share the sanitized API samples too. That should keep our fixtures closer to reality.
lines.zh: 我也分享脱敏接口样本，让fixture更接近实际。

dialogues.title: 评审有明确时段
dialogues.premise: 解析器待评审，Lukas尚有平台工作，站会协调排期。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出评审承诺与不能提前视为完成的事项。

lines.en: The review queue is my main blocker. The change is up for review already.
lines.zh: 主要阻塞是评审队列，变更已经提交评审。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth at eleven this morning. I can't promise approval before reading it.
lines.zh: 上午十一点我有时间，但读之前不能承诺通过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, eleven is review start, right? What's the ETA for initial feedback?
lines.zh: 确认一下，十一点开始评审，对吧？初次反馈预计什么时候？

lines.en: My integration branch depends on its output shape. I can still prepare the adapter tests.
lines.zh: 集成分支依赖输出结构，我仍能先准备适配器测试。

lines.en: Keep the interface description beside the change. Reviewers shouldn't reverse-engineer the expected output.
lines.zh: 变更旁放接口说明，不该让评审者反推预期输出。

lines.en: Okay, I'll add that description before eleven. Maybe ten minutes for the example outputs.
lines.zh: 好，十一点前补说明，示例输出可能需十分钟。

lines.en: Initial feedback should arrive before lunch. Larger design questions may need a separate discussion.
lines.zh: 午饭前给初次反馈，大的设计问题可能另需讨论。

lines.en: We'll circle back at the afternoon checkpoint. Don't mark the review complete before feedback.
lines.zh: 下午检查点再跟进，反馈前不标成评审完成。

lines.en: I can review test clarity in parallel. That doesn't replace Lukas's implementation review.
lines.zh: 我可并行审查测试清晰度，不能替代Lukas审实现。

lines.en: Good, I'll prepare integration fixtures meanwhile. That keeps progress moving without assuming interface approval.
lines.zh: 好，我同时准备集成fixture，不假设接口已获批准。

dialogues.title: 演示成功不等于测试齐全
dialogues.premise: 评审时段确定，Hannah报告尚缺的异常路径测试。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别异常游标、空页和取消操作三项测试缺口。

lines.en: There's a test coverage gap around pagination. Empty pages and repeated cursors aren't covered.
lines.zh: 分页存在测试缺口，空页和重复游标未覆盖。

lines.en: I'm on it with repeated cursor detection. A repeated token must stop pagination safely.
lines.zh: 重复游标检测我来做，重复令牌必须安全停止分页。

lines.en: An empty page can still have continuation. Don't automatically treat it as completion.
lines.zh: 空页仍可能带续页标识，不能自动当作结束。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the API allows that, right? I'll ask its owner for an example.
lines.zh: 确认一下，接口允许这种情况，对吧？我找负责人要例子。

lines.en: Okay, one action item per missing case. Maybe cancellation can pair with parser cleanup.
lines.zh: 好，每个缺口单列任务，取消操作可能与解析器释放资源一起做。

lines.en: We can't rule that out without tests. A successful demo doesn't exercise cancellation behavior.
lines.zh: 没测试就不能排除问题，演示成功没覆盖取消行为。

lines.en: I'll check resource ownership during review. Close the response when the user interrupts.
lines.zh: 评审时检查资源所有权，用户中断要关闭响应。

lines.en: A new paging framework would take longer. Let's park that and test our current loop.
lines.zh: 新分页框架会耗时更多，先放下，测试当前循环。

lines.en: I'll log the unresolved contract question separately. That shouldn't hide the known local gaps.
lines.zh: 未决契约问题单独记录，不能遮住已知本地缺口。

lines.en: Agreed, report test evidence at day's end. No claim of complete coverage until then.
lines.zh: 同意，日终报告测试证据，在那之前不宣称覆盖完整。

dialogues.title: 错误要可辨别也不泄密
dialogues.premise: 测试任务已分配，Raj汇报错误处理实现边界。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解标准错误输出、退出码与敏感信息过滤。

lines.en: Each failure now returns a structured error. Normal inventory output stays clean on stdout.
lines.zh: 失败现在返回结构化错误，标准输出保持纯资产数据。

lines.en: Where do human-readable diagnostics go then? Automation must distinguish failure from empty results.
lines.zh: 可读诊断发到哪里？自动化要区分失败与空结果。

lines.en: Stderr, with documented nonzero exit codes. Just to confirm, no tokens in diagnostics, right?
lines.zh: 标准错误输出，配非零退出码文档。确认一下，不含令牌，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, the read-only scope still needs redaction. Request metadata can contain sensitive query values.
lines.zh: 是，即使只读也需脱敏，请求元数据可能含敏感查询值。

lines.en: Let me tail the log in testing. I'll verify redaction with deliberately sensitive fixtures.
lines.zh: 测试时我检查日志，用专门敏感fixture验证脱敏。

lines.en: Okay, make exit-code documentation an action item. Maybe our shell examples need updates too.
lines.zh: 好，退出码文档列任务，shell示例可能也需更新。

lines.en: Don't catch every exception as authentication failure. Preserve distinct categories and safe diagnostic context.
lines.zh: 不要把所有异常都当认证失败，保留不同类别和安全诊断上下文。

lines.en: I'm on it with explicit exception categories. Unexpected failures retain a sanitized trace identifier.
lines.zh: 我做显式异常分类，意外失败保留脱敏追踪标识。

lines.en: I'll test malformed responses and permission denial. Those should produce different actionable error categories.
lines.zh: 我测试异常响应和权限拒绝，它们应产生可行动的不同错误类别。

lines.en: Good, that's enough detail for the standup. I'll bring sample failures to the follow-up.
lines.zh: 好，站会这些细节够了，会后我带失败样本。

dialogues.title: 接口契约由谁确认
dialogues.premise: 本地实现可推进，真实集成仍等资产API团队确认游标行为。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清外部依赖、负责人和fixture演示的限制。

lines.en: The API contract still needs owner confirmation. We're waiting on empty-page continuation behavior.
lines.zh: 接口契约仍需负责人确认，在等空页续页行为说明。

lines.en: Can the integration work continue with fixtures? Mark assumptions explicitly so they aren't forgotten.
lines.zh: 能用fixture继续集成吗？明确假设，避免遗忘。

lines.en: Yes, but real endpoint acceptance stays blocked. Just to confirm, that's not demo completion, right?
lines.zh: 可以，但真实接口验收仍阻塞，确认一下，这不算演示完成，对吧？

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA from their owner? Use our escalation path if today's reply slips.
lines.zh: 好，对方负责人预计什么时候回复？今天没回就按升级路径联系。

lines.en: Keep the test coverage gap visible separately. External waiting doesn't prevent local boundary tests.
lines.zh: 本地测试缺口单独保留，等外部回复不影响本地边界测试。

lines.en: Maybe the cursor is opaque by design. I'll avoid parsing or modifying its contents.
lines.zh: 游标可能设计为不透明，我不会解析或修改内部内容。

lines.en: Good, pass it back exactly as received. Only validate the documented envelope and limits.
lines.zh: 好，原样传回，只验证文档规定的外层结构与限制。

lines.en: We'll circle back with the API lead. Anika, send the two concrete questions now.
lines.zh: 与接口负责人再跟进，Anika现在发两个具体问题。

lines.en: I can attach failing contract examples. That's more useful than a general compatibility question.
lines.zh: 我附失败契约样例，比笼统兼容问题更有用。

lines.en: I'll send them immediately after this standup. The owner suggested roughly three this afternoon.
lines.zh: 站会后立即发，对方说今天下午大约三点回复。

dialogues.title: 结对看测试而不是接管任务
dialogues.premise: 接口问题明确，Raj请求协助检查游标与取消测试。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别结对协助的范围和任务责任归属。

lines.en: Could someone pair on it before lunch? I need help checking cancellation test design.
lines.zh: 午饭前能有人结对吗？需要帮忙检查取消测试设计。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth for thirty minutes. We'll focus on the test coverage gap.
lines.zh: 我有半小时，聚焦测试覆盖缺口。

lines.en: Just to confirm, Raj keeps implementation ownership, right? Hannah helps validate the failure cases.
lines.zh: 确认一下，实现仍归Raj，对吧？Hannah协助验证失败用例。

lines.en: I'm on it for realistic response samples. Maybe those make cancellation timing less artificial.
lines.zh: 真实响应样本我来准备，能让取消时机不那么人为。

lines.en: Use controlled scheduling in the tests. Real-time sleeps make concurrency tests unreliable.
lines.zh: 测试用可控调度，实际睡眠会让并发测试不稳定。

lines.en: Okay, I'll inject the scheduler for tests. Production behavior doesn't need a new timing policy.
lines.zh: 好，测试注入调度器，生产不必引入新时间策略。

lines.en: Let's take it offline after the standup. We can inspect the test harness together.
lines.zh: 站会后单独聊，一起检查测试框架。

lines.en: Good, today's commitment should remain small enough. Don't turn pairing into a framework rewrite.
lines.zh: 好，今天承诺规模别太大，结对不变成重写框架。

lines.en: I'll review the seam for scheduler injection. Keep it narrow and internal to testing.
lines.zh: 我审查调度器注入点，保持小范围测试用途。

lines.en: I'll join for the first sample walkthrough. Then I'll return to the contract request.
lines.zh: 我参加首个样例讲解，之后回去处理契约请求。

dialogues.title: 让未阻塞任务继续走
dialogues.premise: 结对安排已定，把本地测试与外部契约验收拆开跟踪。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别可独立完成的任务和仍不能合并的集成。

lines.en: Make cancellation tests an independent work item. The API contract remains a separate dependency.
lines.zh: 取消测试单独成任务，接口契约仍是另一项依赖。

lines.en: Does the parser change require that contract? Avoid merging behavior based on guessed semantics.
lines.zh: 解析器变更依赖契约吗？不能基于猜测语义合并。

lines.en: Only the integration adapter needs confirmed semantics. Just to confirm, parser review can proceed, right?
lines.zh: 只有集成适配器需要确认语义，确认一下，解析器评审可继续，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, I'll isolate adapter assumptions in fixtures. Maybe the final response changes one test.
lines.zh: 是，我把适配器假设放fixture里，最终回复可能改变一个测试。

lines.en: Keep contract tests unapproved until confirmation. Passing local fixtures doesn't certify the real endpoint.
lines.zh: 确认前不批准契约测试，本地fixture通过不证明真实接口正确。

lines.en: The parser stays up for review today. Its task includes malformed inputs and resource cleanup.
lines.zh: 解析器今天继续待评审，任务含异常输入与资源释放。

lines.en: The performance benchmark is another separate item. It shouldn't delay functional feedback on parsing.
lines.zh: 性能基准单独列项，不拖延解析功能反馈。

lines.en: Okay, give each action item one owner. Let's park that optional export benchmark for later.
lines.zh: 好，每项任务一个负责人，可选导出基准先放下。

lines.en: I'll attach acceptance evidence to each task. That makes partial completion visible without exaggeration.
lines.zh: 每项任务附验收证据，让部分完成可见但不夸大。

lines.en: Good, the board will show integration waiting. We can finish local work without hiding it.
lines.zh: 好，看板显示集成等待，完成本地工作也不遮住依赖。

dialogues.title: 承诺交证据不是承诺一切完成
dialogues.premise: 任务已拆开，逐人确认今日可交付成果。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别具体承诺、估计时间和依赖条件。

lines.en: We'll use an end-of-day checkpoint today. Just to recap, local testing can proceed independently.
lines.zh: 今天设日终检查点，小结一下，本地测试能独立推进。

lines.en: My commitment is initial review feedback. The review queue won't imply automatic approval.
lines.zh: 我承诺给初次评审反馈，排队评审不意味着自动通过。

lines.en: I'm on it for cancellation and cursor tests. Just to confirm, evidence by five, right?
lines.zh: 我负责取消与游标测试，确认一下，五点前交证据，对吧？

lines.en: I'll obtain the owner's contract response today. If it slips, I'll report the dependency.
lines.zh: 今天争取拿到契约回复，若延期就报告依赖。

lines.en: I'll provide the boundary-test review results. A failing case stays visible until repaired.
lines.zh: 我交边界测试评审结果，失败用例修好前持续可见。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for the demo fixture? Maybe we need a fallback presentation.
lines.zh: 好，演示fixture预计什么时候好？可能需备用演示方案。

lines.en: A fixture demo is fine if labelled. Don't present it as completed live integration.
lines.zh: 明确标注的话fixture演示可以，不能冒充真实集成完成。

lines.en: The fixture demo will be ready by four. I'll include the visible integration limitation.
lines.zh: fixture演示四点前就绪，会显示集成限制。

lines.en: We'll review the acceptance checklist at five. Missing evidence means incomplete, not presumed success.
lines.zh: 五点审验收清单，缺证据就未完成，不能假定成功。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll update the board before then. No deployment decision belongs in today's standup.
lines.zh: 同意，之前更新看板，今天站会不做部署决策。

dialogues.title: 只邀请需要的人深入讨论
dialogues.premise: 今日承诺确定，安排取消测试与契约问题的短讨论。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清会后参与者、议题和结束条件。

lines.en: The follow-up slot starts after this standup. We have a twenty-minute hard stop there.
lines.zh: 站会后开始跟进讨论，二十分钟到点结束。

lines.en: Raj and I will pair on it. Cancellation scheduling is the first concrete topic.
lines.zh: Raj和我结对，第一个具体议题是取消调度。

lines.en: Okay, let's take it offline as agreed. We'll need the sanitized samples there itself.
lines.zh: 好，按约定会后单聊，当场就需要脱敏样本。

lines.en: I'll bring those and join the opening. Maybe ten minutes, then back to integration.
lines.zh: 我带样本参加开头，可能十分钟，之后回去集成。

lines.en: I don't need the full test discussion. Tag me if the interface design changes.
lines.zh: 我不必全程参加测试讨论，接口设计变化再通知我。

lines.en: Good, each new action item gets recorded. The end-of-day checkpoint stays at five.
lines.zh: 好，新增任务逐项记录，日终检查仍在五点。

lines.en: Our output is a deterministic failing test. Not a new architecture proposal this morning.
lines.zh: 产出是确定性失败测试，不是今天上午提新架构。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll bring the current minimal harness. We can demonstrate cancellation without live API access.
lines.zh: 同意，我带最小测试框架，不访问真实接口也能展示取消。

lines.en: I'll start review at eleven as promised. Keep the standup notes linked to tasks.
lines.zh: 按承诺十一点评审，站会记录关联任务。

lines.en: Then I'll send the contract questions now. Everyone has today's next step and owner.
lines.zh: 那我现在发契约问题，大家都明确今天下一步和负责人。
